deadline.value: Apply by December 15 to be considered for guaranteed funding for one year; otherwise the deadline is March 1.
deadline.quote: December 15 to be considered for guaranteed funding for 1 year otherwise March 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: Computer Science has no subject GRE.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact a potential faculty advisor, especially for research assistantships.
supervisor.quote: but are highly encouraged to connect with a potential faculty advisor for a research assistantship

funding.value: Funding is limited; very few first-year PhD students get a teaching assistantship.
funding.quote: First year doctoral students who are admitted with financial support may be supported (very few are available) as a Teaching Assistant for up to three quarters

entry_route.value: Students may enter the PhD with a bachelor's or a master's, with adequate computer science background.
entry_route.quote: Students may enter the doctoral program (Ph.D.) with a bachelor's degree or with a master's degree
